title: pane run --worktree and ship work on a project whose remote is not origin
notes: Retro 2026-11-24. src/main/app/git.ts:67-90 (baseBranch, baseBranchNow) hardcode 'origin' and defaultBranch tries only main/master. insta-experiences has remote 'gitlab' and branch 'develop': 'pane run 1:1 --worktree' answered 'cannot work out which branch on origin is the main one', so its main made 138 worktrees by hand with symlinked node_modules (one hid a broken lockfile merge). Work out the remote (the current branch's upstream, else the only remote, else origin), accept <remote>/HEAD, and let 'project set' name a base branch for a project where neither guess holds. Every other 'origin' assumption on the same path (board on the default branch, pr land, worktree sweep's 'commits no remote has') gets the same remote.
